MP-ASH-Viewer 1.2.0: Active Session History for Oracle (including Standard Edition, without the Diagnostics Pack) and PostgreSQL.

**Download** `MP-ASH-Viewer-v1.2.0.zip`, unzip it and follow `README.txt` (Java 11+ with graphics, the JDBC driver in `lib/`, then `exec_ashv.sh` or `exec_ashv.bat`).

New in this version:

- **PostgreSQL reviewed** (tested on AWS RDS): Compare two periods, filters and favorites, Group by any column, SQL text, CSV export and Admin now work on PostgreSQL connections. The Oracle only screens (Now tabs, ASH Report, Locks, execution plans, SQL / session statistics) are hidden there.
- Compare: the "Compare by" table is no longer squeezed when the wait class table is made taller.

All changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mpontes-stack/MP-ASH-Viewer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
